subtitle: Identify your devices and manage their internet access.
demo_banner: Demo mode · Devices and blocking actions in this dashboard are simulated.
policy_intro: Choose how to manage devices on this network.
policy_paused: Allowlist paused. Permissions are saved and no blocks are requested.
protected_note: The router and this PC are always allowed.
permissions_hint: You can authorize devices before they connect. Permissions are saved for this network.
no_permissions: No devices have been added to the allowlist yet.
initial_devices: Devices will appear here after the scan.
coverage_note: Keep this PC and the application running; you can close the tab. Blocks continue until you disable them or exit the application. IPv6 requires discovering addresses and its router. Network protections may limit blocking.
local_storage: On this PC only · Names and permissions stored locally
name_hint: Leave blank to use the detected name.
mac_hint: Use the MAC address the device uses on this Wi-Fi or Ethernet network.
allow_hint: You can also click Allow on a detected device.
permission_by_mac: Permission saved by MAC for this network
policy_auto_description: Every detected device without permission receives an automatic block request. Click Allow to authorize its MAC.
policy_manual_description: Choose which devices to block. You can prepare the allowlist before enabling it.
search_hint: Try another name or change the filter.
scan_hint: Refresh the network to find connected devices.
invalid_mac_input: Enter a valid MAC address for an individual device.
closing_notice: Closing Network Control and sending connection restoration messages. You can close this tab.
connection_lost: Connection to the application was lost. {detail}
operation_failed: The operation could not be completed.
language_failed: Could not load that language. Please try again.
err_busy: Wait for the current operation to finish.
err_connect_network: Connect the PC to a network with an IPv4 gateway and reopen the application.
err_router_no_response: The router did not respond. Check your connection.
err_gateway_changed: The gateway changed. Reopen the application.
err_scan_before_policy: Refresh the network before configuring permissions.
err_reconnect_panel: Reconnect the dashboard before enabling blocking.
err_auto_allowed: The router and this PC are automatically allowed.
err_device_missing: The device is no longer in the list.
err_name_length: The name must contain no more than 60 characters.
err_protected: The router and this PC are protected.
err_locate_device: Refresh the list to locate the device.
err_ipv6_gateway: No IPv6 gateway was detected for this device. Refresh the network.
err_mac_format: Enter a MAC address with six pairs, for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:02.
err_mac_individual: The MAC must identify an individual device.
err_policy_read: Could not read the saved allowlist.
err_policy_invalid: The saved list is invalid. No automatic blocks were applied.
err_session: Open the dashboard from the ControlRed executable to start a session.
err_payload: Valid data is missing to complete the action.
err_adapters: Windows could not query the network adapters.
err_network_size: This version supports local networks with up to 1024 addresses.
err_install_npcap: Install Npcap to enable control of the physical network.
err_open_adapter: Npcap could not open the adapter. Try Run as administrator. {detail}
err_physical_adapter: Select a physical Ethernet or Wi-Fi adapter.
event_disconnected: Blocking stopped after the dashboard disconnected.
event_recovered: Restoration for the previous session sent.
event_allowlist: Allowlist enabled. Blocking is requested for unauthorized devices when detected.
event_manual: Manual mode enabled. The allowlist has been retained.
cli_exit_hint: Use the dashboard’s Exit button to restore connections and close.
cli_previous_version: Close the previous version using Exit before opening this update.
cli_port_busy: The port is busy. Close the other instance of Network Control.
cli_restore_pending: Restoration is pending. Reopen the application on the same network.
discovery_note: One initial scan at startup; then use Refresh network. Control continues without periodic scans. New devices may appear from observed local traffic; refresh the network if a device is missing.
